title: Hero weapons: Legendary, Seven Star and Vassal
text: There are 21 hero weapons. Four Legendary (Holy) Weapons: Shield, Sword, Spear, Bow. Seven Star Weapons: Hammer, Claw, Axe, Whip, Staff, Gauntlet, Projectile. Ten Vassal Weapons: Carriage, Fan, Scythe, Katana, Book, Mirror, Instrument, Harpoon, Sewing Set, Chain. A player holds one bond. Holy Weapons are one of a kind on the server and shock a wielder who fights with another weapon class (4 damage, never lethal); Seven Star and Vassal weapons are not. Strength: bound wielders hit x4 (x1.5 more for the four Legendary) and x2 more by the anime factor (up to x4 at weapon level 100), techniques cost and cool down half as long, and wielders take 0.6 of normal damage (the Shield wielder 0.2; the Shield reflects 75% of what it soaks, up to 60 per blow). On top comes the power raise: x25 for Seven Star and Vassal, x37.5 for Legendary, growing with the weapon level (from about 5% of the raise at level 0 to all of it at level 100, max level 100). A single hit still stops at 10,000. Server settings (nusmp-heroweapon-server.toml): durationScale 2.0 makes technique effects twice as long (1.0 = the old numbers); anyTarget true lets techniques hit animals, villagers and other creatures, not only monsters (allies and your own pets are spared). The Shield blocks every frontal hit and turns arrows back (shieldVanillaGuard, shieldReflects).
